label: Coverage, from reflexive access, no contingent support and no novel edge
meaning: Coverage is no stronger than the package of reflexive access at w, no contingent concrete support (J1) and the one-way no-novel-edge condition on the concrete subtype: the same supporter covers the target at w. It is strictly weaker: in the rooted-pair control coverage holds while the no-novel-edge condition fails. Conditional consequence only.

strong_version_needed.dd41c165-129a-59d3-84ce-bd13c0944901: The all-world form is needed, not only its selected-world instance: the supporter is found at another world and must be necessary to exist at w. In Control.lateSupport of the NecessarySupportActualScope batch the selected-world instance holds with reflexive access and no novel edge while J1 and coverage fail.
